audits.text:
## be743fd05a59

Source `ed761e8defae468952551cca5b35400b1b21251806998c67210de33bd96337f8`,
selected normalized Racket rule `1ee75c1a7933`; the declaration matches.

**A1 — Reproduced hard-band canonical-profile exclusion.** Canonical profiles
are (8,9,3), (9,10,3), (10,10,3), counting all input colors. Hard samples use
widths 12..14, so no hard sample can hit those profiles. Shared census: easy
7/20, medium 3/20, hard **0/20**; hard envelope hits also 0/20. The pooled 10/60
would hide the missing band without a per-band floor. All three canonical
inputs pass the target validator, so this is a distribution-support issue,
not invalid canonical data.

**A2 — Reproduced ambiguous boundary lessons.** Two plausible rivals,
`echo_overwrite` (paint occupied targets) and `echo_wrap` (wrap off-grid targets),
fit all **3/3 canonical pairs**. Overwrite is refuted in 60/60 generated lessons;
wrap is refuted in only 56/60. In **each of the other four lessons**, wrap fits
every demo but disagrees on the query. Boundary branch occurrence is insufficient
because a wrapped target may be occupied; a branch flag does not establish
output disagreement. In the saved easy lesson, the first two demos contain no
boundary source; the third source at (7,9) wraps to (0,8), already color 1, so
the wrapping rival makes no extra paint. Coordinates are zero-indexed.

Concrete generated counterexample: easy seed `8873691236260`, start index `110`,
default overrides. Full three demos, query input, actual Racket output, rival
output, hashes and command are in
`checks/audit-be743fd05a59-generated-counterexample.json`. The query passes
`self_check` and is genuinely in default sampler support. The other starts are
medium `59491780305268`/44, hard `152749718804554`/110, and hard
`277978776115609`/132, all retained in the final audit report/archive.

**Checked and not found:** canonical/Racket discrepancies 0/3;
validator rejections 0/240 generated pairs; Python rule mirror/Racket mismatches
0/240. These bounded results do not clear the whole generator. Suggested next
repair: canonical anchors in hard mode plus output-level boundary contrast
construction or lesson resampling. No source was modified here.
